summary: Frontend-only investor page verification completed on public preview URL. Validated route sections, nine-scene demo sync, guided run, channel switching, investor links, booking CTAs, waitlist modal, MOCKED disclaimers, reduced-motion behavior, data-testid coverage, and desktop/mobile overflow checks.
critical_code_review_comments: All investor critical interactions tested in this run had data-testid coverage and unique IDs.
MOCKED boundaries are explicitly present in demo and proof sections; no explicit TAM/ARR traction claims were found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Initial broad UI run had two false negatives due timing/visibility checks; targeted rerun with scroll + longer waits confirmed all 9 scene tabs correctly synchronize investor dialogs/checkpoints on desktop and mobile.
rca of the issue: No product defect confirmed in this run. Earlier ontology/mobile dialog failures were test-timing artifacts (insufficient wait before visibility assertion), not functional bugs.
